name: Tortuga
description: US direct-to-consumer travel gear brand founded in 2010, known for carry-on travel backpacks, daypacks and packing accessories designed for city travel; a repeated Wirecutter top pick. It runs an affiliate program through AvantLink and its own Creator Program offering free products, paid content opportunities and commissions on referred sales.

evidence.summary: AffiliateTips (fetched) lists the Tortuga affiliate program details: 10% commission on each sale (coupon sites not allowed), average order value $248, 60-day cookie period, dedicated affiliate manager and freebies for performing affiliates. Multiple travel-affiliate roundups (Carl Broadbent, One More Cup of Coffee) independently report the same 10% rate and 60-day cookie and state the program is delivered by the AvantLink network. No fetched source states any earnings cap, so commission_cap is unknown - a percentage alone is not evidence of uncapped earnings.

Tortuga's own site (via search-indexed page content) runs a 'Join the Tortuga Creator Program' page: accepted creators receive free products, paid content creation opportunities, and commissions on every sale they refer. The page says the brand can only accept a limited number of applicants, but publishes no creator count, so creator_saturation is recorded as unknown rather than low.

reasons: Carry-on travel backpacks are a core, high-intent niche for travel creators, with a $248 reported average order value.
Long-running affiliate and creator programs with product seeding for performing affiliates and a strong review-content culture around the brand.
A published 10% commission on a high average order value; no earnings cap is stated in any fetched source, so the cap stays unknown.
A public creator application page on the brand's own site plus a dedicated affiliate manager reported by program listings.
Applications are reviewed and the creator program accepts a limited number of applicants; AvantLink approval also applies.
Established brand founded in 2010 and a repeated Wirecutter best carry-on pick.

reasons: Parisian fashion with limited-edition drops is an exceptionally strong fit for fashion creators.
Over 6.1M Instagram followers and a launch calendar built around creator sharing.
